definitions.gloss: hanafuda; flower cards; Japanese playing cards
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese card game using a deck of 48 cards divided into 12 suits, each representing a month of the year and its associated flower or plant.

examples.japanese: {花札|はなふだ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{花札|はなふだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather taught me the rules of hanafuda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{花札|はなふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: Playing hanafuda with the family at New Year's is something I look forward to every year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) and ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (card/tag). The 48-card deck has 12 suits corresponding to the months, each featuring seasonal plants: January (⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧, pine), February (⟦{梅|うめ}→梅：01869_ume⟧, plum), March (⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧, cherry), and so on through December.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花札|はなふだ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play hanafuda
- {花札|はなふだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵柄|えがら}→絵柄：13866_egara⟧: hanafuda card designs
- {花札|はなふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧: to deal hanafuda cards

CULTURAL NOTE:
Hanafuda has been played in Japan since the Edo period and remains popular as a family game, especially during ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year). The game company Nintendo originally began as a hanafuda manufacturer in 1889. Common game variants include こいこい and {花合|はなあ}わせ.
